intuition: An increment applied to the bottom k entries can be recorded lazily at the highest affected stack index.

brute_force.approach: Add the increment directly to every one of the bottom k stored values.
brute_force.time: push O(1), pop O(1), increment O(min(k,n))

optimal.approach: Store a deferred increment per entry and propagate it downward only when the corresponding top entry is popped.
optimal.time: push O(1), pop O(1), increment O(1)

edge_cases: Incrementing an empty stack changes nothing, and popping it returns -1.
